question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Customer**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence refers to someone buying or purchasing something, hence the appropriate option is "**customer**". • **Customer **refers to an individual or entity that purchases goods or services from a business or a person who engages in commercial transactions. (एक व्यक्ति या संस्था जो किसी व्यवसाय से सामान या सेवाएँ खरीदता है या कोई व्यक्ति जो वाणिज्यिक लेनदेन में संलग्न होता है) • **Example**: *The customer was satisfied with the quality of the product and the service provided by the store.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Seller **refers to someone who is selling something, not buying. • **Day **refers to a period of 24 hours. • **Women **refer to the female gender. 4a:Tb1d, The correct answer is: **Everything**
